description: What only an iPhone has. On-device dictation (docs/15) is iOS-only by construction — SpeechAnalyzer exists nowhere else — and the plugin's commands are the only thing behind hold-to-talk. Isolated the same way desktop.json isolates autostart: the permission is real on every platform the plugin registers on, but granting it in the shared capability would put a dead ACL entry on desktop and Android, where the composer never offers the bar.
